naming_clarity.reason: 'High-voltage hazards' is understandable stakeholder vocabulary for drivers and technicians.

parent_fit.reason: User story is the root of the V; no parent to trace to.

single_user_capability.reason: One safety goal, but it bundles two audiences and situations (driver in operation, technician during service) whose protections could ship independently.
single_user_capability.suggestion: Consider separate stories for driver protection in operation and technician protection during service, or state the shared capability explicitly.

user_observable.reason: Protection is a user-relevant outcome, but the body states no effect the user actually observes (e.g. warning, safe de-energised state), so it is hard to confirm directly.
user_observable.suggestion: Name what the driver/technician observes, e.g. 'the vehicle warns me and makes the high-voltage system safe before I can touch it'.

variant_consistency.reason: Gated by the spelled-out bev condition; HV exists only in BEV products, so diesel correctly lacks the story.
